title: Distillation column with reflux control
goal: A process engineer can trace overhead condensation and reflux plus the drum-level and reboiler-temperature control loops.

rubric.must: T-201 connects visibly to E-201, D-201, P-201, LV-201, and back to the column reflux connection.
The column bottom visibly connects to E-202 and a return line visibly reconnects to T-201.
LT-201, LIC-201, and LV-201 form a readable loop at the reflux drum.
TT-202, TIC-202, and TV-202 form a readable electric-and-pneumatic steam control loop.
LV-201 and TV-202 control-valve symbols visibly show diaphragm actuation and FC fail position.
PSV-201 is visibly connected to the column overhead.
